from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Literal

class HousingStartRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single monthly housing start data point extracted from a Census Bureau document."""
    month: str | None = Field(description="The month the data represents, formatted YYYY-MM")
    region: Literal["Northeast", "Midwest", "South", "West"] = Field(description="The region for this data point")
    value: float | None = Field(description="Not seasonally adjusted total housing starts in thousands of units")
    source_release_date: str | None = Field(description="The release date of the document containing this record, formatted YYYY-MM-DD, used to resolve conflicts where the latest report prevails")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all housing start records extracted from the collection of documents."""
    housing_start_records: List[HousingStartRecord]
